topics.label: Lecture introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and frames complement within the broader study of immunology.

topics.label: Fundamental principles, nomenclature, and C3 activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the overall architecture, naming conventions, and central pivotal molecule of the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct biochemical pathways that initiate complement and converge on C3 activation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of activated complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement on host cells
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and factors that protect host cells from complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how genetic and acquired deficiencies in specific complement proteins manifest clinically in patients.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the strategies and molecular mechanisms pathogens utilize to escape complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture closing and upcoming topics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
